description: sheets.spreadsheets.values.batchUpdateByDataFilter: POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdateByDataFilter. Sets values in one or more ranges of a spreadsheet. For more information, see Read, write, and search metadata. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID, a valueInputOption, and one or more DataFilterValueRanges.
